blocks.text: Breakfast, then cross the Tancredo Neves Bridge to the Argentine side. Walkways lead through the national park to the top of the falls and right beneath them, with the Devil’s Throat, the most powerful of all, and countless rainbows over the water. After the tour, transfer to the airport for your flight to Buenos Aires; on arrival, a driver takes you to your hotel.
